own_solution.law: The Born rule gives P = integral from a to b of (2/L)sin²(nπx/L) dx = (b-a)/L - [sin(2nπb/L)-sin(2nπa/L)]/(2nπ). With L=3 nm, n=2, a=0.6 nm and b=1.5 nm, P=0.3467744642.
assumptions: The stated stationary state describes the electron immediately before the measurement.
The probe performs an ideal position measurement over its response interval.
Changing the response boundary changes the detection interval while preserving the specified electron state and well.
